The most common permits:

Over the Counter Permit
Over the Counter Permit Building Department
This application is for all over the counter permits: Minor Electrical, Minor Plumbing, Minor Mechanical, Water Heater Replacement, Window & Door Replacement, Re-Roof, Siding, Rot Repair, Stair Repair etc.
Apply for Permit
Encroachment Permit
Encroachment Permit Building Department
This permit is required for any work in the City ROW. Typically City's ROW includes all streets and also extend 10-feet +/- as measured from the face of curb toward private property. If you are working in this zone, you will need an encroachment permit. If you would like an annual encroachment permit covering multiple projects (not typical), or a permit for a project not tied to a specific address please contact City Hall. (707) 464-9506.
Apply for Permit
Building Permit New or Remodel of non-residential or mixed-use properties
Commercial Building Permits Building Department
This application is for non-residential properties.
Apply for Permit View Knowledge

Notice to Applicants for Business Licenses and  Commercial Building Permits:

Disability Access Requirement and Resources.pdf Download

Building Permit New Residential or Residential Remodel
Residential Building Permits Building Department
This application is for new residential or remodel projects.
Apply for Permit
Fence Permits
Fence Permit Building Department
This permit covers all fences that do not require an encroachment permit. If an encroachment permit is needed, you will need this fence permit and an encroachment permit.
Apply for Permit

Privacy Policy

Scope

MyGov takes your privacy seriously. This policy explains how MyGov collects, uses and protects Information submitted and collected as part of its web-based service and generally on its website (together, the Website).

Information means information that determines the identity of an individual.

Collection

Registration Data: When registering on our Website you will provide Information (such as, company name, individual name, address, phone number and email address).

Cookies: Our servers may retain information in cookies about your session when you enter and use our Website.

Uses

Use of Information: We will use Information to provide our service, provide support, and to improve our Website.

Cookies: We use cookies and other collected information to improve and further develop our Website, to keep your session active and to customize your experience. The cookies are stored on your computer. You can delete them or reject them, but if you do you cannot use our service.

Aggregate Non-Identifiable Information: We use aggregate non-identifiable information to improve our Website.

Server Logs: Our server logs record system information when you view our Website.

Email Marketing: You may receive marketing emails from us. You can always ‘unsubscribe‘ or ‘opt-out’ of those emails within the body of the email.

Service Providers: We do not disclose Information to third parties, except to certain service providers:

  • credit card processors,
  • Google Analytics,
  • Digicert,
  • Rackspace, and
  • other contractors providing services on our behalf.

Disclosure and Sharing

Legal Requirements: We may be required by law to disclose your Information, and we will try to take steps to limit any such disclosure.

Change of Ownership: If we are acquired or otherwise sell our business, we will transfer all of the Information to the successor entity. We will try to notify you of any change in ownership or sale by either posting it on our site or by emailing you (at the email address in the system).

Other Terms

Application of this Policy: By registering on our Website, you agree to comply with the terms of this Privacy Policy and that we may process your Information.

Industry Standard Security: While we use industry standard security measures to protect against the loss, misuse and alteration of the information under our control, there is no guaranty that our service cannot be compromised.

Privacy Complaints:

  • Contact Us First (Please): If you have a dispute or complaint about privacy practices, please contact us and we will do our best to resolve it!
  • Contact: support@mygov.us
  • Physical Address:
    MyGov, LLC
    P.O. Box 1192
    Ada, OK 74821

Links to Third Party Sites: Our websites may contain links to other sites and services, which are owned and controlled by others. These websites have their own policies regarding privacy, and you should review those policies.

Revisions to this Policy: We may change this policy at any time. Notice of any significant revision will be called out on this website for a period of time.
